transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve been forgetting little things more than I should. Like returning calls, turning in a form, or stopping for an errand on the way home. It’s not huge, but it’s been enough that I thought I should come in.
How long have you been experiencing these memory problems?
It’s been more noticeable for… maybe the last 15 months. Around when I started an evening certificate program, it got harder to keep track of things.
Are these memory problems causing any difficulties in your daily life or work?

Yeah… a bit. I’m still managing, mostly, but I’ve missed some small follow-ups at work and a few school deadlines. Not huge things, but enough that I’m worried people might start seeing me as unreliable… especially since I’d like to be considered for an Office Manager role.
Have you noticed any difficulty with learning new information?
Not really sure. I mean, if someone shows me something new, I can usually pick it up… it just might take me a little time to get settled with it. I haven’t noticed a big problem with learning itself.
Have you been feeling anxious or depressed lately?
Um… not really, I don’t think. I mean, I get stressed sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been especially anxious or depressed.
Have you ever found yourself unsure of the date, time, or your location?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I might lose track of the day if I’m busy, but I know where I am and what time it is, generally.
Do you ever feel confused or disoriented?
Not really… I don’t think I feel confused or disoriented. Maybe just distracted sometimes, but not like I don’t know what’s going on.
Do you have trouble focusing or paying attention to things?
Yeah… sometimes. Like at work, if a phone rings or people are talking near me, I’ll lose track of what I was doing. Even just some random thought about something at home can pull me off task.
Do you ever find yourself struggling to find the right words when you're talking or writing?
Not really… I mean, sometimes I pause if I’m tired or something, but I haven’t noticed it being a real problem.
Do you find it harder to make decisions than you used to?
I’m not sure… I haven’t really noticed that being harder than before. Maybe I take a bit to decide sometimes, but I think that’s pretty normal.
Do you feel more mentally tired than you used to?
I don’t know… not more than usual, I guess. I get tired sometimes, but I haven’t really thought of it as mentally tired or anything.
Do you find that you can remember things you learned or did a while ago, or does it seem like that information slips away from you?
I think I remember most things from a while ago okay. I mean, nothing really stands out as slipping away… not that I’ve noticed.
Do you find it hard to concentrate on tasks for long periods of time?

Yeah… I guess with longer stuff, it’s harder. Like if I have to sit and read a long chapter or write out a plan, I tend to put it off until it’s late, and then I’m kind of rushing through it after work.
Do you have trouble remembering things that happened before your memory problems started?
Um… I don’t think so. I haven’t really noticed anything like that.
Do you have trouble recalling past events or conversations?
Not really… I mean, I can usually remember past events or conversations okay. I haven’t noticed a problem with that.
Do you have trouble remembering things that happened recently, like what you did yesterday or last week?
Not really. I mean, yesterday or last week… I can usually remember the general stuff. I haven’t noticed a big issue with that.
Do you have trouble remembering things from your childhood or teenage years?
I don’t think so… I mean, I remember bits and pieces from back then like most people, I guess. Nothing that feels like a problem.
Do you have trouble recalling memories from before the problems with forgetting little things started?
I’m not sure… I don’t think I have trouble with memories from before that. Nothing really stands out to me.
Do you have trouble remembering things that happened before you started noticing these memory problems?
I don’t think so. I mean… I haven’t really noticed a problem remembering things from before all that.
Do you find it harder to remember to do things in the future, like appointments or tasks you need to complete?

Yeah… somewhat. It’s mostly little things I’m supposed to do later, like returning a call or dropping off a form, or remembering to stop for an errand on the way home. That’s kind of what made me think I should ask about it.
